title: Restless Graves

objectives.journal: Go to the old graveyard at night.
Put down three of the risen dead.

returnText: Return to Bram at the post
nextHint: Bram has more to say about the graves.

offer: There's an old graveyard out along the road.
At night, something walks there. Bones, standing up.
I don't go there after dark. Not any more.
Go and look, after sundown. Will you?
active: Go at night. After sundown. Be careful.
ready: Three of them? And you walked back. Good.
Here, 20 coins. Grave work should pay.
There's more to this. Talk to me again.
done: The graves are quieter. For now.
